adb895c22f.q: What was Summer Shaw's role at Alphabet's Moonshot Factory X and what types of projects did she work on?

f78ee2d1ff.q: Why did Summer Shaw transition from McKinsey and Google X to Missouri state government, and what impact did COVID-19 have on her work there?
f78ee2d1ff.a: Shaw was frustrated that long-term moonshot projects wouldn't have near-term impact on people for 10+ years. She moved to Missouri state government to see immediate impact, and COVID happened while she was working there, making impact obvious in every part of the work and requiring her to manage workforce coordination and public health challenges across 50,000 state employees.

636d296e02.q: How did Summer Shaw's experience in government shape her decision to pursue a dual JD-MBA degree from Stanford?
636d296e02.a: While working in government, Shaw saw how important it is to understand the law and how great lawyers are at thinking through problems. This experience led her to apply for the JD degree at Stanford, and later she added the MBA to her application while deferring from New York state government, ultimately receiving the Knight-Hennessy scholarship to pursue both degrees simultaneously.

1bae913c08.q: What is Attian AI and what is its business model for advising companies on artificial intelligence?
1bae913c08.a: Attian AI is a consultancy founded by Summer Shaw that has advised over 100 companies on AI strategy and adoption. The company evolved from executive education courses at Stanford Business School and Berkeley Haas into strategy projects and now focuses on helping companies build production-ready AI products and agents, primarily serving small to mid-sized businesses that lack the budget and resources of larger enterprises.

dee82a1960.q: Why does Attian AI focus on serving small to mid-sized businesses rather than large enterprises for AI implementation?
dee82a1960.a: Shaw explained that while big companies have the ability to invest in AI and get ahead, smaller businesses risk getting more and more left behind if they don't figure out AI themselves. She wanted to focus on this set because there is a huge need for support with AI in that space, and it aligns with her impact-driven mindset of ensuring medium-sized businesses don't fall behind.
